name: Filigree Mask
line: Gold wire fountains from the bridge of the nose into a lace of buds, leaves and granulation, with crimped roses at the jaw.

name: Floral Crown
line: A halo of gold roses, beaded sprays and veined leaves rising from a single slim band.

name: Filigree Sunglasses
line: Round dark lenses framed in gold, wreathed in leaves and buds, with a granulated medallion at the bridge.

name: Filigree Bun Cage
line: An openwork gold dome of leaves, florets and bead sprays, crowned by a winged creature with ladder-veined wings.

name: Filigree Finger Armour
line: An openwork shield for the index finger and fine vine rings for the others, ending in bead-tipped tendrils.

name: Floral Ear Cuff · Study
line: The maker's drawing of the piece that belongs on the empty pedestal.
